plan.goal: Report the binary .bed size, per-chromosome file count, and per-chromosome .bed size for a GWAS genotype dataset of 3619 samples and 5218614 variants.
plan.rationale: This is a pure calculation task for a PLINK binary .bed dataset. The .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant, so full size = n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB. Per-chromosome size uses the largest chromosome's variant count (946884) with the same 2-bits rule. The number of per-chromosome files is assumed to be the standard human chromosome split (24 files: chr 1-22, X, Y; 25 if MT included), inferred from the variant counts being consistent with a human dense array.
caveats: The number of per-chromosome files (24 or 25) is an assumption based on a human genome split (chr 1-22, X, Y, ± MT); confirm the exact chromosome list before scripting per-chromosome jobs.
The per-chromosome .bed size (856.7 MB) is for the largest chromosome (946884 variants); smaller chromosomes will be proportionally smaller.
Full-dataset size (4721.5 MB) assumes all 5218614 variants are in a single .bed; if already split, sum the per-chromosome files instead.
